name: ArticleTranslator
author: Codex
description: Translate FreshRSS article titles and content into Simplified Chinese paragraph by paragraph using OpenAI-compatible APIs, Ollama, Gemini, or LM Studio.

0.1.4: Ignore ArticleSummary UI when collecting article text for translation
Add a final body-text fallback for feeds whose content is not wrapped in paragraph elements
0.1.3: Decode multiply escaped FreshRSS controller URLs before requesting translation parameters
Keep title translations visible in ThreePanesView when the copied article header is hidden
Trim provider base URLs before normalizing LM Studio and OpenAI-compatible endpoints
0.1.2: Fix FreshRSS controller URLs being double-escaped in data-request attributes
Decode HTML entities in the browser before calling the translation endpoint
0.1.1: Normalize LM Studio and OpenAI-compatible URLs that were entered as full /v1/chat/completions endpoints
Show whether HTTP errors came from the FreshRSS extension endpoint or the AI API endpoint
0.1.0: Initial release with title translation and paragraph-by-paragraph article translation
Displays Chinese translations directly under the original title and source paragraphs
Supports OpenAI-compatible APIs, Ollama, Gemini, and LM Studio
